notes: PLEA test run 6 on Sepolia (chain 11155111): the run-5 delivery (job e0891351, launch #1691, parked by the launch rehearsal) plus three fixes: the agreed mainnet clock is checked in PleaLaunch.seed instead of CabalGate's constructor (the rehearsal's bare EVM has chain id 1), the gate scores an appeal's share band on the lesser of its own share and the original's (a floor-raised appeal keeps its band), and the Tribunal never holds an excluded seller's plea. Deploy exactly PLEA, CabalGate, Seasons, PleaDistributor and PleaLaunch in the listed order, with zero ETH, in one atomic factory transaction. PLEA and PleaDistributor receive $owner; PleaLaunch reads its owner from PLEA and registers the system during construction. Atomic deployment prevents another caller from taking PLEA's deployment-block registration window. CabalGate's arguments specify Intake v2, the oracle fee asset, pool TestIMD, the attestation signer, 18000-second seasons and a 118800-second dead-man. Seasons uses the same pool TestIMD. PleaLaunch specifies the Sepolia v4 PoolManager, pool TestIMD, Stacker, credit gas 1300000, START 1792162800 (2026-10-16 15:00 UTC), and the same oracle fee asset. The static bool word 1 enables minting Sepolia's test oracle fee. PleaLaunch's 12th and 13th arguments are the keccak256 hashes of the accepted build's argument-free Letterbox and Tribunal creation code. The nonzero Tribunal commitment enables Objection!. Letterbox, Tribunal and PleaHook are present in the accepted source and deployed separately after this five-contract transaction through PleaLaunch's committed-code deployment functions; these are not manifest initialization calls. The hook requires a mined flag-compatible CREATE2 salt. Its deployment mints 82% of PLEA to the hook, 6% to Seasons and 12% to PleaDistributor. The distributor's owner sets one Merkle root for the swarm's 10% and the 2% airdrop. Seasons pays the top 25 eligible wallets with at least 60 points, using shareBps for both IMD and the 10000000 PLEA bonus in each of the first six seasons. Trading opens through seed(): the launch owner may call any time after hook deployment; anyone may call from START. Neither seed nor the later deployments are part of this manifest's constructor-only launch.
